title: Four new sesquiterpene glycosides from the aerial parts of Saposhnikovia divaricata (Turcz.) Schischk.
authors: Zhang, Yi-Qiang; Zhang, Qian; Meng, Xin; Liu, Zhen-Qiang; Liu, Zhen-Yun; Hu, Wei-Tao; Jiang, Peng; Luo, Yu-Meng; Guan, Wei; Hao, Zhi-Chao; Chen, Qing-Shan; Zhang, Li-Li; Liu, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文从植物中分离鉴定倍半萜糖苷并测试抗炎活性，仅涉及小分子与NF-κB p65蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Four undescribed isodaucane-type sesquiterpene glycosides (1-4) and five known megastigmane-type sesquiterpenes (5-9) were isolated from the aerial parts of Saposhnikovia divaricata (Turcz.) Schischk. The planar structures and absolute configurations of 1-4 were determined by spectroscopic techniques, DP4+ probability analysis, X-ray crystallography, and ECD calculations. Concurrently, the anti-inflammatory activity of the isolated compounds was assessed in RAW264.7 cells. Among them, 4 exhibited potent anti-inflammatory effects against NO production, with an IC(50) value of 7.21 +/- 0.86 muM. Notably, it showed potent activity in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. Although the underlying mechanism remains to be fully elucidated, CETSA and molecular docking studies demonstrated that compound 4 directly interacted with NF-kappaB p65 protein, suggesting a possible involvement of the NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 从防风（Saposhnikovia divaricata (Turcz.) Schischk.）的地上部分分离得到4个未描述的异胡萝卜烷型倍半萜苷（1-4）和5个已知的巨豆烷型倍半萜（5-9）。通过光谱技术、DP4+概率分析、X射线晶体学和ECD计算确定了1-4的平面结构和绝对构型。同时，在RAW264.7细胞中评估了分离化合物的抗炎活性。其中，化合物4对NO产生表现出强效的抗炎作用，IC(50)值为7.21 ± 0.86 μM。值得注意的是，它在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中显示出强效活性。尽管其潜在机制尚待完全阐明，但CETSA和分子对接研究表明，化合物4直接与NF-κB p65蛋白相互作用，提示可能涉及NF-κB通路。
